ccRestart.dialogTitle: Bump the settings generation and let each CC self-restart?
ccRestart.dialogBody:
{{count}} live CC detected (this preview is a snapshot taken when opened).
Running bumps the settings generation by +1. Each CC self-restarts (exit→resume) when it next reaches a Stop point.
No process is killed directly (window position is preserved by in-window swap). Busy CCs that never stop are not applied until they reach a Stop.
ccRestart.queued: Bumped to generation {{generation}}. Each CC self-restarts when it next reaches a Stop. Detected: {{total}} total / {{resolved}} resolved / {{resumeOnly}} resume-only / {{unresolved}} unresolved (busy CCs that never stop are not applied until a Stop).
ccRestart.queuedPartial: Bump to generation {{generation}} succeeded (each CC self-restarts at its next Stop). Re-detecting live CC right after failed: {{error}}
ccRestart.pxpipeWarn: ⚠ Failed to ensure the pxpipe proxy (restart continues): {{reason}}
ccRestart.error: An error occurred while restarting CC

goldenReconcile.title: Golden configuration update
goldenReconcile.description: {{n}} file(s) have differences that need your decision. Choose per row (if the defaults look right, just press Run).
goldenReconcile.backupNote: {{n}} file(s) set to overwrite will be backed up first.

impactHint.no-op: Applying changes nothing (only the ledger is out of date).
impactHint.rollback: The distribution has not moved since it was deployed; only your copy is newer. Overwriting discards your change and gains nothing.
impactHint.merge: Both the distribution and your copy changed. Overwriting backs up your copy first.
impactHint.unknown-base: There is no deploy record, so the origin of your copy cannot be determined. Overwriting backs it up first.

actionDescription.apply: Overwrite local file with distribution content. Your existing copy is backed up.
actionDescription.promote: Keep local changes and promote to local distribution overlay for future deploys.
actionDescription.propose: Promote locally and launch Claude Code to draft and propose a GitHub Issue upstream.
actionDescription.defer: Make no changes now; ask again on next application launch.
actionDescription.unmanage: Stop tracking this file; no future diff confirmations will be asked.
actionDescription.consult: Launch Claude Code to compare diffs and perform manual merge or consultation.

goldenReconcile.undoSuccess: Restored file before overwrite and applied to overlay.
goldenReconcile.proposeLaunched: Claude Code proposal assistant launched. Request packet:
goldenReconcile.proposeAutoExitNote: Claude Code will search for duplicate issues and guide you through submission after confirming backup and promotion (will automatically stop after 60 seconds).
goldenReconcile.proposeAttentionNote: Warning: The diff contains attention points such as absolute paths. Please review in terminal before submitting.
goldenReconcile.proposeConsultMixedNote: Note: The launched Claude Code session will automatically exit in 60 seconds.
goldenReconcile.consultLaunched: Claude Code launched. Request packet: {{path}}. When done, restart CCPIT and choose the existing promote action on the re-presented rows.
goldenReconcile.consultFailed: Claude Code could not be launched; no decisions were applied: {{reason}}
goldenReconcile.resolveSummary: Of {{requested}} requested: overwritten {{applied}} / sent {{promoted}} / stopped asking {{unmanaged}} / deferred {{deferred}} / backups {{backups}}
goldenReconcile.promotedNote: Sent {{n}} file(s) to the distribution source. Location:
goldenReconcile.promotedDurable: This location is outside the application, so it survives app updates and reinstalls. Your content will be deployed from now on.
goldenReconcile.promotedVolatile: Warning: this location is inside the application resources and will be lost when the app is updated or reinstalled.

skipReason.not-pending: No longer needed confirmation, so nothing was done.
skipReason.stale-destination: The local file changed while the dialog was open, so it was not acted on under that approval.
skipReason.no-base-record: There is no deploy record, so it cannot be sent to the distribution source.
skipReason.promote-failed: Writing to the distribution source failed.
skipReason.no-ledger: The deploy record could not be read, so nothing was done. It will be rebuilt on the next launch.

blocked.source-unreadable: The source could not be read, so the update was stopped for safety.
blocked.path-collisions: Path collisions were detected, so the update was stopped for safety.

goldenPromotion.title: Golden Promotion Browser
goldenPromotion.subtitle: Manage rescue of out-of-band golden assets and regular promotion of local skills (Developer Mode only).
goldenPromotion.markDistributedHint: Click after git push instruction and completion
goldenPromotion.noSelection: Please select an item from the list.
goldenPromotion.confirmDialogDescription: The following {{count}} items will be applied to golden. A formal exclusive lease and atomic transaction will be executed via the contract tool.
goldenPromotion.confirmDialogUnviewedWarning: ⚠️ {{count}} items have not been reviewed in the detail pane yet. Please review their content before approving.
goldenPromotion.applySuccessMessage: Successfully applied atomically via contract tool (Commit SHA: {{sha}}). State is 'Applied (unpushed)'. Please push to remote separately.
goldenPromotion.confirmWithdrawDesc: Skill '{{name}}' will be withdrawn from Golden (delete patch applied via contract tool). The file will be safely quarantined and can be restored anytime.
goldenPromotion.confirmRestoreDesc: Skill '{{name}}' will be re-added to Golden.
goldenPromotion.identicalTooltip: Already identical to Golden (No approval needed)
goldenPromotion.identicalNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: your local copy is already identical to Golden, so there is nothing to promote. To change it, edit your local copy and press "Refresh".
goldenPromotion.rescueIdenticalTooltip: The rescued content is already identical to Golden (nothing to promote)
goldenPromotion.rescueIdenticalNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: the rescued content is already identical to Golden, so there is nothing to promote.
goldenPromotion.proposalIdenticalTooltip: The proposal content is already identical to Golden, so there is nothing to promote. You may reject this proposal in the "Skill candidates".
goldenPromotion.proposalIdenticalNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: the proposal content is already identical to Golden, so there is nothing to promote. You may reject this proposal in the "Skill candidates".
goldenPromotion.staleLocalTooltip: Your local copy matches an older Golden version. Promoting it would roll Golden back, so it cannot be selected. Restart CCPIT, and the startup Golden reconcile can bring your copy up to date.
goldenPromotion.staleLocalNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: your local copy matches an older Golden version, and promoting it would roll Golden back. To bring your copy up to date, restart CCPIT and let the startup Golden reconcile handle it (an untouched copy follows automatically). If a confirmation appears, choose "Overwrite (with backup)".
goldenPromotion.divergedTooltip: Both Golden and your local copy have changed. Promoting it as is would lose one side, so it cannot be selected. In the startup Golden reconcile confirmation, choose "Consult Claude Code".
goldenPromotion.divergedNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: both Golden and your local copy have changed, and promoting it as is would lose one side. In the startup Golden reconcile confirmation dialog, choose "Consult Claude Code" for this item. If it is not shown, restart CCPIT and check again.
goldenPromotion.divergedPaneBody: Both Golden and your local copy have been updated. Promoting it directly would lose one side. In the startup Golden reconcile confirmation dialog, choose "Consult Claude Code" and compare the two sides before sorting them out.
goldenPromotion.proposalDivergedTooltip: The proposal's base version differs from the current Golden, so it cannot be selected. Submit a proposal rewritten on the current Golden, or reject this one in the "Skill candidates".
goldenPromotion.proposalDivergedNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: the proposal's base version differs from the current Golden (see the difference note in the details pane for the reason). Submit a proposal rewritten on the current Golden, or reject this proposal in the "Skill candidates".
goldenPromotion.proposalDivergedBadgeTitle: Proposal base differs from the current Golden
goldenPromotion.proposalDivergedPaneTitle: The proposal's base differs from the current Golden
goldenPromotion.proposalDivergedPaneBody: This proposal was written on a different version than the current Golden. Promoting it would roll back Golden's changes. Submit a proposal rewritten on the current Golden, or reject this one in the "Skill candidates".
goldenPromotion.conflictBadgeTooltip: {{count}} proposals for the same skill can be promoted, so none of them can be selected
goldenPromotion.conflictRowTooltip: {{count}} proposals for the same skill can be promoted, so none of them can be selected. Reject the unwanted ones in the "Skill candidates" until only one remains. The details pane on the right lists the others.
goldenPromotion.conflictNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: {{count}} proposals for the same skill can be promoted. Check the others in the details pane, then reject the unwanted ones in the "Skill candidates" so that only one remains.
goldenPromotion.waitingRowLine: Waiting for composite {{composite}} to be promoted
goldenPromotion.composedBadgeTitle: This proposal's content is merged into the composite proposal. Promoting the composite also marks this one as adopted
goldenPromotion.waitingBadgeTitle: This proposal was not chosen as a source of the composite. It is set aside until the composite's promotion finishes
goldenPromotion.composedTooltip: Merged into composite {{composite}}. It cannot be selected on its own. Promoting the composite also marks this proposal as adopted.
goldenPromotion.waitingTooltip: Waiting for composite {{composite}} (it was not chosen as a source). It cannot be selected until the composite's promotion finishes.
goldenPromotion.composedNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: this proposal is merged into composite {{composite}}. Promote the composite instead (this proposal is marked adopted with it).
goldenPromotion.waitingNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: this proposal was not chosen as a source and is waiting for composite {{composite}} to be promoted. When that finishes, it returns as "proposal is out of date".
goldenPromotion.composedPaneBody: This proposal is merged into composite {{composite}}. Promoting it on its own would roll golden back, so it cannot be selected. Promoting the composite also marks this proposal as adopted. To bring it back, reject the composite in the "Skill candidates".
goldenPromotion.waitingPaneBody: This proposal was not chosen as a source of the composite. It is set aside until composite {{composite}} is promoted (or rejected), so the same skill's promotion is not stopped by a conflict. After the promotion it returns as "proposal is out of date" (golden has moved) and can be chosen as a source again. To bring it back sooner, reject the composite in the "Skill candidates" (no other action is needed).
goldenPromotion.pendingBadgeTitle: This proposal is merged into a composite proposal that cannot be promoted yet (it needs an approving independent review)
goldenPromotion.pendingTooltip: Merged into composite {{composite}} (awaiting approval; it cannot be promoted yet). It cannot be selected on its own.
goldenPromotion.pendingNotice: "{{skill}}" cannot be selected: this proposal is merged into composite {{composite}}, which is awaiting approval. After its independent review approves it, approve the composite in the promotion screen.
goldenPromotion.pendingPaneTitle: Merged into a composite proposal (awaiting approval)
goldenPromotion.pendingPaneBody: This proposal is merged into composite {{composite}}, which has no approving independent review yet and cannot be promoted. Once approved, approve the composite in the promotion screen (this proposal is marked adopted with it). To bring it back, reject the composite in the "Skill candidates".
goldenPromotion.holdAbnormalMissing: The MD of composite {{composite}} was not found in the proposal pool. It cannot be rejected in the "Skill candidates", so use the button below to discard the composition.
goldenPromotion.holdAbnormalAdopted: Composite {{composite}} is marked adopted, but its application to golden cannot be confirmed. Discarding the composition with the button below brings the proposals back.
goldenPromotion.holdAbnormalChanged: The MD of composite {{composite}} was changed after registration and no longer matches the registered content, so it cannot be promoted. Discarding the composition with the button below brings the proposals back.
goldenPromotion.composeDiscardButton: Discard this composition and bring the proposals back
goldenPromotion.composeDiscardDone: The composition was discarded. The held proposals are back among the candidates.
goldenPromotion.composeDiscardConfirm: Discard this composition (press again to confirm)
goldenPromotion.conflictCardTitle: Selection is blocked by conflicting proposals
goldenPromotion.conflictCardWhy: {{count}} proposals for the skill "{{skill}}" can be promoted. To prevent one of them from being promoted silently, none of them can be selected.
goldenPromotion.conflictPeerMissing: Not in the list, so its state here is unavailable
goldenPromotion.conflictCardExitSteps: 1. Open "Skill candidates" in the left menu. 2. Find the proposals above (title, date, Request ID). 3. Mark the unwanted ones as "Rejected". 4. Press "Refresh" on this screen; the remaining one becomes selectable.
goldenPromotion.conflictCardDismissNote: "Dismiss" on this screen does not resolve it (it only changes the state in this browser; the conflict count does not change).
goldenPromotion.conflictCardOtherNote: Proposals whose base version differs from the current golden, and proposals identical to golden, cannot be promoted and are not counted as conflicts.
goldenPromotion.conflictCardExitInPlace: Or press "Reject this proposal" on a proposal above, right on this screen (one confirmation).
goldenPromotion.conflictRejected: The proposal was rejected. The list was refreshed; check the remaining conflicts.
goldenPromotion.rescueEmptyDesc: Backdoor commit candidates (rescue targets) are currently 0 items. The emergency escape is standing by normally.
goldenPromotion.legendBadgeAdoptedDesc: CCPIT Adopted (Blue): Skills introduced via CCPIT adoption mechanism (~/.ccpit/adopted-skills.json). Default recommended target.
goldenPromotion.legendBadgeUnviewedDesc: Unviewed (Amber): Skills whose content has not been reviewed yet. Automatically cleared when reviewed in the right pane (warned in approval confirmation dialog).
goldenPromotion.hiddenTooltip: Excluded from recommended breakdown: Not adopted by CCPIT (In Golden: {{golden}} items, Unknown origin: {{unknown}} items)
